business_type: secular grower (leading-edge foundry monopoly with geopolitical overlay)
moat_source: process leadership no competitor has matched for a decade plus customer co-design lock-in; evidence: 66.2% gross margin as a manufacturer, every major AI designer forced onto its 2nm roadmap, wafer prices RISING into 2027

returns.assumption_note: Convergence to scenario IV by year 5, ~60% of the gap closed by year 3. Excludes dividend (~1.3%/yr).

sensitivity_key_driver: terminal multiple (how much geopolitical discount the market applies in 2031)
primary_model_risk: Geopolitical multiple: TSM's fundamentals support the bull case operationally, but the terminal multiple is hostage to cross-strait risk perception. The +91% twelve-month run compressed the historical Taiwan discount to near zero at exactly the moment concentration in AI revenue (61% HPC) peaked. A sentiment reversion alone - no operational miss required - produces the bear case.
expectations_gap_key_variable: the vanished Taiwan discount: at ~33x trailing (vs a forward 22.8x that itself assumes the >30% growth lands), the market prices TSM like a US megacap without the geopolitical tail; our base case restores a 20x terminal and lands ~40% below the quote
top_5_bull_arguments: The only company on Earth that can manufacture leading-edge AI silicon at scale - competitive risk Low, pricing power proven (wafer prices rising in 2027)
FY2026 guidance raised to >30% USD growth with 66% gross margins - monopoly economics in their prime
2nm migration is compulsory for the entire AI chip complex in 2027 - revenue visibility few companies ever achieve
HPC/AI at 61% of revenue means TSM taxes every AI winner regardless of which one prevails
Fortress balance sheet and dividends through the largest capex cycle in its history
top_5_bear_arguments: Expected IV ($263.30) is ~40% below the price; even the bull case ($402) falls short of today's quote
The Taiwan discount has evaporated after +91% in 12 months - the tail risk has not
$52-56B capex plus overseas-fab cost premiums pressure both FCF and the famous margins
61% HPC concentration makes TSM the single largest casualty of any AI-capex digestion
Middle East supply-chain exposure (helium, hydrogen, energy) flagged by management itself
thesis_breakers: Cross-strait escalation (blockade, gray-zone interference with shipping/fabs)
Gross margin below 60% for two consecutive quarters (2nm/overseas dilution exceeding plan)
A major customer (Nvidia/Apple) dual-sourcing leading-edge to Samsung/Intel at volume
position_size_recommendation: 0-1% at current price; the franchise deserves a permanent watchlist slot - accumulation zone near expected IV (~$263), which geopolitical scares have historically delivered
notes_on_nulls: ROIC/ROE/ROA null: not captured as sourced ratios. Revenue/margin/guidance/capex are reported (results and guidance); the FCF path nets guided capex against margin-implied operating cash flow - confidence_level medium. ADR-share math implied from cap/price.
historical_context: Directional context only - low confidence. Verified datapoints: +91.08% over 52 weeks, all-time-high close 477.57 on June 30, 2026, -3.99% past week, trailing P/E 33.33 vs forward 22.77 (pass1/search). No verified historical multiple range beyond this captured.
